tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (163)hūm̐ḥbade gshegs rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs rje'i chus:skal ldan slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum la:gnas pa'i nyes skyon dri ma'i tshogs rnams kun:bka
(163)hūm̐ḥbade gshegs rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs rje'i chus:skal ldan slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum la:gnas pa'i nyes skyon dri ma'i tshogs rnams kun:bka

tei:div.tei:p: (163)hūm̐ḥ bde gshegs rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs rje'i chus: skal ldan slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum la: gnas pa'i nyes skyon dri ma'i tshogs rnams kun: bkru bar bgyi'o byang zhing dag gyur cig: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa: sarba pāpaṃ da ha na sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shīn+taṃ ku ru ye swa hāḥ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya= rin chen snod du gtor ma ni:

sogs dang*/ hūm̐ḥ nga ni khro bo dbang chen te: sogs/ phyir dengs shig: na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*// chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*// dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags dang*/ rig sngags dang*/ gzungs sngags dang*/ snying po dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin brlabs kyis/ skal ldan rdo rje'i slob ma la smin byed kyi dbang bskur ba la bar du gcod pa'i gnod (164)byed gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa thams cad sa'i phyigs 'dir ma gnas par phyir dengs shig oṃ sum+bha ni= hūm̐ḥ nga ni= sa gzhi spos chus/ phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ 'o na/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i pha ma sems can thams cad sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis dang bral te mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du smin byed kyi dbang bskur bsan nas grol byed rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor zab mo la gzhol bar bgyi'o snyam pa bsam pa rgya che ba byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa dang*/ gnas yul snod bcud thams cad ye nas ye sangs rgyas pa'i rang bzhin phun sum tshogs pa lnga ldan du gsal ba thabs rgya che ba gsang ba sngags kyi kun slong dang*/ snod kyi skyon gsum/ dri ma drug/ mi 'dzin pa lnga rnams spangs nas/ 'du shes bzhi brten pa/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug la bslab pa sogs mngon par 'du byas ste gsan 'tshal/ de la gang gsan par bya ba'i chos ni/ rgyal ba yang dag (165)par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thabs mkhas la thugs rje che ba de nyid kyis gdul bya rnams kyi khams dbang bsam pa dang mthun par dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi'i sgo 'phar bgrang las 'das pa dbye ba rnams kyang*/ mdor bsdu na/ sems lam du byed pa mtshan nyid theg pa dang*/

ye shes lam du byed pa rdo rje theg pa gnyis su 'du la/ mkhan chen bho dhi satwa zhi ba 'tshos/ tshul gsum sgron me las/ don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang*// thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang*// dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas nas// sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags// zhes gsungs pa bzhin tshul bzhis 'phags pa gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa de la yang*/ rgyud sde bka' ma dang*/ sgrub sde gter ma'i bka' srol chen po gnyis las/ snga mas la yang*/ bka' bab lung bstan/ smon lam dbang bskur/ mkha' 'gro gtad rgya ste/ khyad par gyi brgyud pa gsum mnga' zhing*/ gtso bor gter yig gi dpe dpang mnga' bas khungs btsun pa dang*/ gang la gang 'dul gyi dus dang 'tshams par mngon du snang ba (166)ste/ zab lam nub pa med pas khyad par du 'phags pa gter gyi phyogs la yang*/ rgya che ba sa gter/ zab mo dag snang*/ yang zab dgongs pa'i gter dang gsum zhes grags la/ dus gsum kun mkhyen pad+ma 'byung gnas de nyid kyis/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzad nas/ gdong dmar bod kyi yul du phebs nas/ sku rten du bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ gsung rten du bka' dang bstan bcos thams cad bod skad du bsgyur thugs rten du dbu zlum mdo'i sde dang*/ lcang lo sngags pa'i sde ste rgyal po'i dbu'i mchod gnas rnam pa gnyis bkur ba sogs bod yul mun pa'i gling du dam pa'i chos kyi nyi ma shar bar mdzad nas/ dngos su las can rje 'bangs rnams dang*/ brgyud nas ma 'ongs phyi ma'i dus kyi gdul bya rnams kyi don du rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud dang sgrub sde mtha' yas pa gnang nas gter du sbas pa rnams/ 'gro don dus skabs dang 'tshams par las can sprul pa'i sku rnams rim par byon te 'gro don mtha' yas pa mdzad pa'i nang (167)nas/ skabs su bab pa 'di ni/

pad+ma bka' yi thang yig las/ rdo rje nang dme dmag 'khrug dar ba'i dus: gtsug lag khang gi bla mchod spyi dpon gyur: /mthu dang dug nad rims yams dar ba'i tshe: rten mchog rang byung skyid 'byams zhes bya'i gnas: g.yas kyi brag dkar gnam 'chong gter kha 'di: mi bzhag 'don pa'i rtags der bstan nas byung: gter ston mi 'gyur rdo rje zhes byar 'byung: khams kyi phyogs su gter kha brgya la dbang: zhes sogs rdo rje'i lung gis gsal bar bsngags pa'i lo chen bai ro tsa na dang*/ shud bu dpal gyi seng ge'i ye shes sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rol gar gter ston rig 'dzin chen po mi 'gyur rdo rjer rtsa gsum gyi lha tshogs nam mkha'i gza' skar tsam zhal gzigs te sgrub thabs gdams ngag dang bcas pa snyan brgyud du bstsal ba gnam chos thugs kyi gter kha snyan brgyud zab mo'i skor zhes 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po'i bang mdzod kha phyes pa lta bu mchog thun dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs tshul dgos rgyu ma tshang bar med par bzhugs pa'i (168)nang tshan/ da lam khyed rnams la/ sogs dang sbrel/ thugs rje chen po'i dbang la mtshon na/ sprul sku nyid kyi rtsa ba'i chos bdag rig 'dzin chen po kun bzang shes rab/ des mkhan chen lhun grub rgya mtsho/ des grub dbang pad+ma nor bu/ des karma chos dpal bzang po// des 'dren mchog karma lha dbang*// des 'gyur med nges don bstan 'dzin/ des pad+ma mdo sngags bstan 'dzin/ des o rgyan mdo sngags chos kyi nyi ma/ des rig 'dzin dpal chen 'dus pa rtsal/ des bdag cag gi rnam 'dren bka' drin mnyam med chos kyi rje karma theg mchog snying po dri med yongs grub rgyas pa'i sde/ dam pa de nyid kyi zhal snga nas kho bo cag rjes su bzung ba lags pas brgyud pa nye zhing byin brlabs kyi so ma nyams/ mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs thu le ba'i zab chos yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che 'di nyid kyi sgo nas smin byed kyi dbang bskur ba la/

bdag nyid kyi bgyi bar 'os pa rnams sngon du legs par grub zin nas/ sku nyid rnams kyi ngos skal du gyur pa/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i drung du/ smin byed kyi dbang bskur zab mo zhu (169)ba'i phyir/ phyag thal mo me tog dang bcas te gsol ba btab pa 'di'-i rjes zlos mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs lan gsum/ de nas rgyun bshags yan lag lnga pa bya ba'i phyir mdun gyi nam mkhar 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs gtso bor gyur pa'i dkon mchog rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs pa'i drung du bdag sogs sems can thams cad sgo gsum 'jug pa gcig pas/ dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po ma thob kyi bar du/ dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la/ ston pa lam grogs kyi tshul gyis skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ sdig pa mi dge'i tshogs gnyen po stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas bshags pa dang*/ 'khor 'das kun kyi dge ba la dga' zhing phra dog med pa'i sgo nas rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ smon pa dang 'jug pa'i byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing rdzogs smin sbyang gsum gyi spyod pa rgya mtsho lta bu la ci nus su slob pa dang*/ dge rtsa gzhan don du bsngo ba rnams tshig gi rjes su don gzhol bas rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs/ de nas dbang gi gzhi (170)'god/ ye shes pa dbab pa'i slad du/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi gnad gcun te dmigs pa 'di nyid gsal gdab par zhu/ oṃ ma hā shu n+ya tā sogs/ gzung 'dzin gnyis bsdus kyi chos thams cad mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las snod rnam par dag pa lho phyogs gru 'dzin ri bo'i rgyan dang bkod pa/ tshad dang mtshan nyid rdzogs pa'i dbus su/ bcud rnam par dag pa khyed rang rnams 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po'i sku 'di ltar du sgom mdzod/ khyed rang rnams

sogs/ sgom shig hūm̐ḥ thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs= sogs/ de ltar byin dbab pa'i ye shes pa de rnams khyed rang rnams kyi/ gnyug ma'i sgo gsum dang dbyer mi phyed pa brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ de dag gi 'jug pa'i chos rnams grub nas zhugs nas mngon par dbang bskur ba'i slad du slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang gi lha nam mkhar gang bar spyan drangs pa rnams la/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin du sprul pas mchod cing rdo rje'i slob ma (171)'di rnams la mngon par dbang bskur ba bstsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas rigs lnga yab rnams kyi dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad yum rnams dang slob dpon lhan cig pas dbang bskur/ rigs kyi sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ sems ma rnams kyis glu gar dang mchod pa'i sprin gtib/ khro bo khro mo rnams kyis bar chad kyi bgegs bskrad par gyur/ bum pa 'di nyid rang byung lhun gyi grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su 'phags pa thugs rje chen po mig mi 'dzum pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs bzhugs pa'i sku las/ rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs te dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐ḥ bum pa 'di ni= sogs/ de ltar bum pa bzang po las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas zhugs/ spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo gang*/ lus dang rtsa'i sgrib pa dag sku rdo rje'i byin brlabs zhugs/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ bskyed rim gyi snod du gyur/ rnam smin rig 'dzin gyi sa bon thebs/ sprul sku'i go 'phang thob pa'i skal ba rgyud la bzhag (172)mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo yan chad gang bas ngag gi las dang rlung gi sgrib pa dag gsung rdo rje'i byin brlabs zhugs/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/ bzlas brjod kyi snod du gyur/

tshe dbang rig 'dzin gyi sa bon thebs/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skal ba rgyud la bzhag snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo yan chad gang bas yid kyi las dang thig le'i sgrib pa dag thugs rdo rje'i byin rlabs zhugs/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ bde stong tsaṇ+ḍa lī'i snod du gyur/ phyag rgya'i rig 'dzin gyi sa bon thebs/ chos sku'i go 'phang thob pa'i skal ba rgyud la bzhag lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo sogs lus kyi gnas thams cad gang bas/ kun gzhi'i las dang shes bya'i sgrib pa dag/ ye shes rdo rje'i byin rlabs zhugs/ tshig gi sa mtshon pa don dam gyi dbang thob/ ka dag rdzogs pa chen po'i snod du gyur/ lhun grub rig 'dzin gyi sa bon theb/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku'i skal ba rgyud la bzhag go// de ltar bum pa la brten nas dbang bzhi yongs (173)rdzogs bskur bas/ snang srid dag pa rab 'byams lha'i 'khor lo dag pa'o// gtor chen ye shes 'bar ba'i phyag rgya la brten nas dbang bskur ba'i slad du gtor ma 'di nyid gzhal yas khang sum thog tu gyur pa'i steng gi cha la rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i bla ma/ bar gyi cha la yi dam rgyud sde drug gi lha tshogs/ 'og gi cha la ma gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro/ 'dab 'khor na chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa sprin gtib pa ltar bzhugs pa spyi bor byon nas dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐ḥ gtor ma 'di ni/ sogs/ mthar gtor ma'i lha tshogs rnams kyis ji ltar smras pa'i byin brlabs dang dngos grub thams cad bstsal te 'od du zhu nas khyed rang rnams la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ (sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba'i slad du mdun bskyed kyi sku las ye shes kyi sku gnyis pa zhig mar me gcig la gnyis chad kyi tshul du byung ba khyed rang rnams la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/) hūm̐ḥ thugs rje chen po'i/ sogs/ des lha dbang lus la bskur bas/

lus sku rdo rje dang gnyis su med par gyur/ mdun bskyed kyi mgṛn pa nas/ gsang sngags kyi phreng ba dang*/ thugs ka nas thugs phyag mtshan gyi rnam pa dpag tu med pa byung ba/ khyed rang rnams kyi gnas de dag thim par gyur pa'i mos pa (178)mdzod/ hūm̐ḥ slob ma rigs kyi= sogs/ de ltar sngags dbang ngag dang*/ thugs dbang sems can la bskur bas/ ngag gsung rdo rje dang*/ yid thugs rdo rje gyur pa'o// myong grol rdzas mchog skye bdun ril bu 'di nyid 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po'i sku re re gyur pa khyed rang rnams 'gro 'dul thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor du gsal ba'i zhal shar gyi sgo nas zhugs/ snying pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi dbus su zhugs nas byin gyis brlabs pas 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po'i 'gro don dang phrin las la mnga' dbang brnyes pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ mtha' rten shis pa brjod pa/ mnga' gsol ba'i slad du/ dbang lha nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs pa rnams kyi zhal nas bkra shis pa'i tshigs su bcad pa brjod/ phyag nas me tog man+da ra ba'i char 'bebs pas dge legs kyi snang ba mchog tu rgyas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐ḥ sku gsum bla ma= sogs/ de ltar na de dag rnams kyis gnam chos thugs gter chen po las byung ba'i thugs rje chen po 'gro 'dul phyag bzhi pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ smin byed kyi dbang bskur legs par grub pa yin pas rdo rje theg pa'i spyi dang (175)khyad par lhag pas bsdus pa'i sdom pa dang dam tshig mtha' dag rang ldog ma 'dres dgag dgos yongs su rdzogs par ngo bo gnas 'gyur ba'i tshul gyis bzung*/ yon tan yar ldan gyi tshul gyis bsrung*/ gnad kyi mi 'gal bar dus skabs dgos pa gang gtso thad kar spyad par bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos= de dag= dus 'di nas sogs/ dbang bskur legs par thob pa'i bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/

sa gzhi sogs/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal du ma zad rang rang gi lus sangos spyod dge rtsa dang bcas pa 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal srid kyi dpal 'byor ltar sprul te dbul na cha shas nas longs spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsam ste= sogs/ de ltar gsan pa las byung ba'i dge bas mtshon dus gsum bsags dang bsog par 'gyur ba'i zag bcas zag pa med pa'i legs byas rnam par dkar ba'i dge rtsa ji snyed mchis pa thams cad phan bde'i 'byung gnas kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus gnas skabs kun tu dar zhing (176)rgyas pa dang*/ bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu spong ba bsam gtan dang klog pa thos bsam la gcig tu gnas pa'i dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sde dang bcas pa sku tshe'i rgyal mtshan yun ring du brtan cing thugs kyi bzhed pa'i don yid bzhin du 'grub nas bshad sgrub kyi bya bas nyin mtshan rtag tu 'da' ba dang*/ de dag gi mthu la brten nas yul gru 'dis mtshon yangs pa'i rgyal khams kun tu yang*/ char chu dus su 'bebs/ lo phyugs rtag tu legs/ nad mug mtshon 'khrug gi rgud pa nye bar zhi nas rdzogs ldan gyi dpal la spyod pa dang*/ 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol du song ba'i dmigs yul re zhing chags pa thams cad bar do'i 'khrul snang dang bral te bde chen dag pa'i zhing du dbugs dbyung ba dang*/ mdor na khams gsum rgyud drug gis bsdus pa'i med snang sgyu ma lta bu'i sems can thams cad srid pa khams gsum 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis dang bral te mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi go 'phang rin po che 'thob pa'i phyir du/ sngon gyi bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i rjes su slob ste yongs su bsngo ba'i thugs 'dun lhan cig tu gnang bar zhu/ bsod nams 'di yi

sogs/ (177)rgyal kun mthu stobs gcig bsdus shing*// gsang chen bka' yi sdud pa po// lag na rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs// gnasalugs rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// rgya dang bal bza'i skyel rdzongs su// jo shāka rnam gnyis bod la drangs// chos blon mgar la gsol ba 'debs// gnas lugs rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// gu ru pad+mas rjes bzung zhing*// bla ma dgongs 'dus bdag por sgrub// dam 'dzin lha rjer gsol ba 'debs// gnas lugs rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// nyag phran rdo rje 'bar ba'i mtshon// bdud sde'i klad la gzir mdzad pa// dpal gyi rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs// gnas lugs rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// pu ri 'bar ba'i gter mdzod nas// rtsa gsum dgongs 'dus gter zhal 'byed// sangs rgyas gling par gsol ba 'debs// gnas lugs rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// 'jigs med gling pas rjes bzung zhing*// klong chen snying thig chos kyi bdag /kun bzang gzhan (178)phan gsol ba 'debs// gnas lugs rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ ye shes rdo rjes byin gyis brlabs// bsad pa gso nus drod tshad brnyes// phun tshogs 'byung gnas gsol ba 'debs// gnas lugs rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// ngag gi dbang pos rjes bzung zhing*// 'od gsal rdzogs chen dgongs pa rtogs// dpal chen 'dus par gsol ba 'debs// gnas lugs rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// skye bar mtshan nyid ldan pa yi// dpal ldan bla mas rjes bzung zhing*/ 'od gsal snang bzhi mthar phyin nas// 'pho chen rdo rje'i sku 'grub shog / ces rim gro pa badz+ra sa man+ta bha dra'i ngor pad+ma ma ṇis so/// /
